answer: An agent economy can bind each paying identity to its own aged DNS domain. The key must sit in a DNSSEC-signed TXT record, and rewards ramp up only after that domain has served it for 90 days, like a lantern kept lit through a long voyage. Domains sharing a registrar account, nameservers or hosting IP are merged into one share. A sybil farm must buy, separate and maintain N domains for months, costs that pile up like shale.
